hubTrigger.claim: China inflation remained near zero and producer-price deflation deepened, prompting the causal question of where input-cost relief could transfer margins.

causalNeighborhood: Do not buy commodity users generically. Search for companies with stable/regulated output pricing, high sensitivity to a falling commodity input and evidence that lower input cost is already reaching reported earnings.

validation.claim: Q1 attributable profit RMB2.25bn, +335.3%; company explicitly attributed domestic power earnings improvement to lower coal prices plus higher electricity prices.
Q5500 thermal coal around RMB820/t and failed to rise into peak summer demand.
Q5500 coal fell from roughly RMB1175/t at the start of 2023 to about RMB795/t in mid/late June, around a 32% decline; supply/import growth and weak demand were cited.

candidates.name: 华能国际

expectationEvidence.claim: Q1 turnaround and fuel-cost decline were already recognized; May-12 share price RMB9.86, target RMB11.90; stock had already risen 21.3% over three months.

risks: large renewable/overseas earnings mix complicates pure thermal-power expression

candidates.name: 华电国际

evidence.claim: Q1 attributable profit +82.3%; company cited lower coal prices and higher electricity/heat prices.

risks: investment income/coal holdings complicate consolidated sensitivity

nextGate: freeze price absorption at 2023-06-30; reject if the margin transfer was already highly absorbed without a fresh magnitude reset
